en: The postcard features an old multistory building with timber frames and a distinctive pointed tower. The setting is lush and green, with trees and hills in the background, suggesting a scenic, possibly spa-town location. The front is filled with handwritten text in German around the image, and part of the text reads 'Christliches Hospiz' and 'Bad Pyrmont.' The reverse side has handwritten address details, a blue museum stamp, and an early 20th-century German postage stamp.
